UC-1249.en: Not enough credits for a search. Add credits to keep searching.
UC-1249.note: Clauseo Case Law out of credit (the host's out_of_credit status), the same words in Settings › Connectors, the library's Case Law card and by the composer, and in the row of the host's case_law_out_of_credit notice; no figure (the out-of-credit status carries none). Replaces, by the composer, U15-64 "Out of case-law credits." and U15-65 "Searches of Indian Kanoon stop until you add more."; in Settings, U15-28 "No credits left. Case-law searches stop until you add more.". Those three are retired.

UC-1291.en: No credits. Add credits to search.
UC-1291.note: Clauseo Case Law at exactly 0 credits (out of credit, or a never-funded account the host calls signed in): Settings › Connectors, the library's Case Law card and the composer; never "Ready to search." or "Running low". Replaces the library's UC-1232 "No credits left" (retired).

UC-1460.en: Credits added. Ask again to search case law.
UC-1460.note: By the composer of a conversation that holds the host's case_law_out_of_credit notice after the lawyer's last message, once credit is back (not out); read from the conversation's own entries, so it holds after a reload, in a second window and for a conversation opened later. The next message ends it. Nothing resends.

UC-1463.en: Not enough credits for a search.
UC-1463.note: Settings › Connectors out of credit when no packs are listed and the status has no pay link: UC-1249 without its "Add credits to keep searching.". New.

UC-1464.note: Settings › Connectors at 0 credits when no packs are listed and the status has no pay link: UC-1291 without its "Add credits to search.". New.

UC-1465.en: Clauseo Case Law couldn't search here: out of credits.
UC-1465.note: The row of the host's case_law_out_of_credit notice, at the point in the conversation where a search was refused: what happened, past tense, no button; it stays as history after credits arrive. The composer strip keeps UC-1249/UC-1291 and Add credits. New (in place of the never-approved UC-1462).
